dialogue.small_talk.1: Nice to see you, {other}. How has your day been?
dialogue.small_talk.2: Can't complain. Same old, same old.
dialogue.small_talk.3: Funny how the days blur together around here.
dialogue.work.2: Sounds like you've earned a rest.
dialogue.work.3: I keep thinking about tomorrow's tasks.
dialogue.food.1: Have you eaten yet, {other}? I'm starving.
dialogue.food.2: Not yet. Something warm sounds good.
dialogue.food.3: We should share a meal sometime.
dialogue.town_news.1: Did you hear what's going on in town, {other}?
dialogue.town_news.2: Something new every day, it seems.
dialogue.town_news.3: I like how this place keeps changing.
dialogue.personal.1: Can I tell you something, {other}? I've been thinking a lot lately.
dialogue.personal.3: It means a lot to have someone to talk to.
dialogue.complaint.1: Honestly, {other}, things have been getting to me.
dialogue.complaint.2: I know. It's been a rough stretch.
dialogue.complaint.3: Thanks for hearing me out, I suppose.
memory.conversation.complaint: Complained to {other} about how things were going.
ui.inspect.title: Resident
dialogue.small_talk.formal.1: Good to see you, {other}. I hope the day is treating you well.
dialogue.small_talk.formal.2: Quite well, thank you. And you?
dialogue.small_talk.formal.3: Can't complain. It is a pleasant town.
dialogue.small_talk.close.1: There you are, {other}! I was hoping I'd run into you.
dialogue.small_talk.close.2: Ha, same here. I've got so much to tell you.
dialogue.small_talk.low.1: Hello, {other}. I'm not really in the mood today.
dialogue.small_talk.low.2: That's all right. We don't have to talk much.
dialogue.small_talk.low.3: Thanks. Just having you here helps.
dialogue.work.low.1: Work has been wearing me down, {other}.
dialogue.work.low.2: I know the feeling. Hang in there.
dialogue.remember.2: I do. That was a good day.
dialogue.remember.3: We should do that again sometime.
memory.conversation.remember: Looked back on old times with {other}.
